items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Couldn't say any more because Zutty was going to introduce him to me.

ctx.x: It was in the Spring time and he had a big Panama hat. And I said, he said, there he is Marge there with the hat on. I said, woooee! (LAUGHTER). That is Don Redman.
Couldn't say any more because Zutty was going to introduce him to me.
Marge was, well the way I'd built him up, Marge thought he was a powerful man you know.
